validation: All 100 decisions validated against their full saved committee records and recomputed voting outcomes using the respective Chemistry coordinator. Source hashes allow the plotting script to verify the published decision snapshots.
aggregation_rules: Each completed simulation receives equal weight. Both models contribute 50 simulations.
Configurations merge laureate-order differences while preserving separate prize parts and recipient combinations.
Top-five plots retain the denominator of all 100 simulations.
limitations: Observed simulation frequencies are not calibrated Nobel probabilities.

Terra uses 52 candidates and five neutral profile versions; Claude uses 69 candidates, with 41 original-profile simulations and nine neutral-profile simulations. Both pools contain Car-Parrinello and targeted protein degradation.
The models do not use identical candidate pools and profile allocations, so their difference is not a controlled estimate of model effects.
